meta.note: Questions were written from the SYNTHETIC documents, so scores are optimistic. relevant_chunks lists chunks that contain the answer and is not exhaustive. expected_facts must appear (case and whitespace normalised) in the relevant chunks. absent_terms must not appear in any chunk the model can retrieve. tests/test_eval_gold.py checks both against data/processed/chunks.jsonl.

splits.dev: retrieval mode and DENSE_MIN_SIM tuning only
splits.heldout: run once after tuning is frozen
